title: Portable biomarker triage assistant for multi-site oncology cohorts

claimReviews.text: The model generalizes across oncology patient populations and hospital settings.

findings.message: Claim claim-generalizable-oncology asserts populations not represented in linked evidence: pediatric, underrepresented ancestry.
findings.action: Narrow the claim wording or add external validation for each missing population.

findings.message: Claim claim-generalizable-oncology asserts settings not represented in linked evidence: community hospital, international site.
findings.action: Add site-level validation evidence or mark the setting as a future research gap.

findings.message: Claim claim-generalizable-oncology references unsupported assay or instrument contexts: single-cell-rna-seq.
findings.action: Separate assay-specific claims and document conversion limits before reviewer release.

findings.message: Claim claim-generalizable-oncology references runtime environments not covered by rerun evidence: cuda, cpu-only.
findings.action: Run the pipeline in each deployment-like environment or downgrade deployment readiness language.

findings.message: Claim claim-generalizable-oncology has broad transfer language without external validation evidence.
findings.action: Hold broad generalizability language until at least one independent validation artifact is linked.

findings.message: Strong claim claim-generalizable-oncology does not cover required subgroup evidence: pediatric, underrepresented ancestry.
findings.action: Convert the claim to qualified language or create a subgroup-specific validation plan.

claimReviews.text: The manuscript includes enough artifacts for an independent lab to rerun the triage pipeline.

safetyNotes: No external APIs, credentials, private manuscripts, or live clinical data are used.
